announce.description: Announce URL for the torrent; omit for trackerless torrents (BEP-5).

filelist.description: Path to filelist file (or '-' for stdin) containing files to include in the torrent, formatted as 'filesystem_path|torrent_path'. Required when using -f.

name.description: Name of the torrent (required for filelist mode, or to override the default name from input path).

piecelength.description: Piece length in bytes (overrides default 262144). Must be 0 if piecesize is non-zero.

piecesize.description: Exponent for piece length (2^size), e.g., 18 for 262144 bytes. Overrides piecelength.

comment.description: User comment to embed in the .torrent file.

private.description: Whether the torrent is private (0 or 1, BEP-27).

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp to use as creation date; 0 means omit default timestamp (use current time).

nodate.description: If true, omit the creation date field entirely (D option).

creator.description: Value to use for the 'created by' field in the torrent.

nocreatedby.description: If true, omit the 'created by' field entirely (B option).

md5sum.description: If true, add MD5 sum per file (m option).

sortorder.description: Filename sorting method when building from directory: 'Unsorted', 'Alpha', or 'Version'.
